title: JavaScript Beginner Mock Test 3
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for JavaScript at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about const and let is valid?

options.text: const does not make a referenced object deeply immutable

declare stable bindings with const and state that changes with let
It can only be used inside a class

questions.explanation: const does not make a referenced object deeply immutable. Verify this behavior with a minimal runnable example and observable output.
